user.title: Connect to the e-distribución add-on
user.description: Enter the address of the `edistribucion` add-on (defaults to the same Home Assistant instance).

zeroconf_confirm.title: e-distribución add-on found on the network
zeroconf_confirm.description: An e-distribución add-on was found at {host}:{port}. Do you want to add it?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the add-on. Check that it's started and the host/port are correct.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the add-on found on the network.

init.title: e-distribución options: general settings
init.description: Only the update interval is global. After this step, you'll configure each of your {num_supplies} supply points separately: tariff type, power and energy prices, PVPC zone, and surplus compensation — all per supply point, since each contract can differ. Contracted power (kW) isn't asked for: it's read automatically from your e-distribución contract.

supply_point.title: Supply point {position}/{total}: {cups}
supply_point.description:
{address} ({estado})

Choose whether to track this supply point, set an alias, and pick the tariff type (fixed/time-of-use/pvpc), the power term price, the energy prices for the chosen tariff, surplus compensation, and (if using pvpc) the zone. Contracted power (kW) is read automatically from e-distribución — no need to type it in.

Tomorrow's pvpc prices are published around 20:15 the day before — no key or signup needed, it uses REE's public price file.

data.holiday_region: Holiday region (if tariff is 'time-of-use'): a weekday holiday counts as off-peak
data.pvpc_zone: PVPC zone (if tariff is 'pvpc'): Peninsula/Balearic Islands/Canary Islands, or Ceuta and Melilla

month_vs_last_year.name: Comparison vs. same month last year

addon_connection_failed.title: Can't connect to the e-distribución add-on
addon_connection_failed.description: Several calls to the add-on have failed in a row. Check under Settings → Add-ons → e-distribución that it's running, review its Log tab, and confirm the host/port configured in this integration are correct.

invalid_credentials.title: Invalid credentials in the e-distribución add-on
invalid_credentials.description: The add-on rejected the login due to an incorrect DNI/password. Fix them under Settings → Add-ons → e-distribución → Configuration, and restart the add-on.
